verdict.rationale: Notion's own materials describe in-product AI answers with citations and agents that keep work moving. The Agent APIs reference chatting with a Notion Agent and streaming its replies, which points to a first-party AI assistant working over workspace data. The evidence consists of short marketing taglines and API references, though, not documentation of insight or suggestion features. Missing for 10: detailed docs on in-product AI insights or proactive suggestions drawn from user data (e.g. database analysis, summaries), a description of the depth and scope of the data analyzed, and hands-on or independent corroboration of answer quality.
